name: Add montage
summary: Adds a standard MNE electrode or fNIRS montage (10-20, 10-05, BioSemi, EGI and others) to raw MEG/EEG data, with optional channel renaming, and outputs the data, a sensor plot and a QC report.
description: Optionally renames channels (old-new pairs) to match the montage naming, builds the montage with mne.channels.make_standard_montage and applies it with raw.set_montage, then saves the raw file, a sensor-position plot, a PSD plot and an HTML QC report. Use it before topographic plotting or source localisation of EEG data that lack channel positions. Channel names must match the montage after renaming.

inputs.description: Continuous MEG/EEG recording in MNE raw .fif format.

outputs.description: Raw data with channel positions from the montage (raw.fif).

parameters.description: Name of the standard MNE montage to apply.

options.label: Standard 10-05
options.description: Electrodes are named and positioned according to the international 10-05 system (343+3 locations)

options.label: Standard 10-20 (94+3)
options.description: Electrodes are named and positioned according to the international 10-20 system (94+3 locations)

options.label: LETTER-NUMBER (65+3)
options.description: Electrodes are named with LETTER-NUMBER combinations (A1, B2, F4, …) (65+3 locations)

options.label: 10-20 with postfixes (100+3)
options.description: Electrodes are named according to the international 10-20 system using postfixes for intermediate positions (100+3 locations)

options.label: 10-20 with prefixes (74+3)
options.description: Electrodes are named according to the international 10-20 system using prefixes for intermediate positions (74+3 locations)

options.label: 10-20 with prime marks (' and ") (100+3)
options.description: Electrodes are named according to the international 10-20 system using prime marks (' and '') for intermediate positions (100+3 locations)

options.label: HydroCel Geodesic 32 + Cz
options.description: HydroCel Geodesic Sensor Net and Cz (33+3 locations)

options.label: HydroCel Geodesic 64 + Cz
options.description: HydroCel Geodesic Sensor Net and Cz (65+3 locations)

options.label: HydroCel Geodesic 128 + Cz
options.description: HydroCel Geodesic Sensor Net and Cz (129+3 locations)

options.label: HydroCel Geodesic 256 + Cz
options.description: HydroCel Geodesic Sensor Net and Cz (257+3 locations)

options.label: MGH 60
options.description: The (older) 60-channel cap used at MGH (60+3 locations)

options.label: MGH 70
options.description: The (newer) 70-channel BrainVision cap used at MGH (70+3 locations)

options.label: BrainProducts 10-10
options.description: Brain Products with 10-10 electrode names (128 channels)

parameters.description:
If the names of channels in your data acquisition system are different from the names in a standard montage, you can use this option to rename the channels in the montage to match your data file (e.g. 'Cz' in 'GSN-HydroCel-257' can be named 'E257' in older EGI acquisition software).
Usage: type in name of the channel in the montage, dash, and the name used in your dataset (Cz-E257, or E001-E1, for example).

citations.text: Gramfort A, et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Front Neurosci 7(267):1-13 (2013).
